component.name: Composa
component.summary: Layer-based image editor for compositing and retouching

description.p: Composa is a layer-based image editor for compositing and retouching, with Photoshop-style tools and shortcuts. It is a from-scratch implementation of Compositor, Robbie Tilton's open-source macOS app.

ul.li: Layers with masks, clipping, blend modes, groups and layer effects
Selections: marquee, lasso, magic wand, object and subject selection, feathering
Brush, eraser, clone, heal, dodge, burn and sharpen, with pen pressure
Adjustments: levels, curves, hue and saturation, exposure, colour balance and more
Text layers, transforms, rulers, guides, grid and snapping
Opens Photoshop files and camera RAW; exports PNG, JPEG and WebP

description.p: FLUX Generative Fill has independent defaults of 4 px mask grow, 8 px blend, 4 px conditioning blur and 1.2 context. Advanced and context preview use these values; Expand and GPT settings remain unchanged.

Editable masks preserve unmasked generated context pixels for FLUX and GPT. Optional context outlines, stable floating-panel placement, updated Crop frames, automatic GPT Expand prompts, session-only API key entry and separate requested workflow defaults.

Shared native MCP and Assistant tools, structured document inspection, validated layer batches, persistent task journals and independently verified edit results. AI selection supports add/subtract modifiers, workflow assignments are task-specific and generation dialogs share ordered reference controls. Verified with 732 automated tests and six real-model acceptance scenarios.

GPT edits cropped source images with independent context padding and ordered references. Masks stay local, results return to their saved coordinates with one soft blend, and FLUX workflows remain unchanged.

Direct editable-shape recoloring for the Assistant, region-aware AI object selection, new removal-brush and bucket tools, ready crop frames, full-header panel dragging, clearer GPT mask targets and bounded seamless expansion with a fixed prompt.

GPT masked edits preserve untouched background, use inward final feathering and explicit aspect-preserving dimensions. Expand supports empty-area-only or whole-image modes, workflow selection and minimum-side sizing. Image Edit and other full-image operations no longer require selections. Workflow prompts are independent; generation controls are consistent, costs show credits and USD, LoRA strength allows numeric 0–3 input, and healing no longer skips remapped repair pixels.

Official GPT Image 2.5 Comfy.org Partner Node pack with ordered references, context-aware masked editing, runtime API-key authentication and server-derived cost estimates. The floating panel has a workflow selector, compact one/two/three variants and centered reference image icons. FLUX supports three model-only LoRAs with independent strengths. Native content-aware fill and healing use bounded coherent exemplar synthesis.

Images dropped onto the tab strip open separate documents. Masked Klein edits use source-latent conditioning and automatic Pixaroma crop/stitch support with smooth seam blending. Remove no longer synthesizes grain. An editable appearance-preservation prompt and separate conditioning blur and color-match settings are available.

One or three AI variants with sequential List or native Batch execution, separate Advanced options, and exact x2/x4 upscaling. Lightweight soft brushes improve edge quality. Embedded smart objects open layered contents in a tab and support shared instances, independent copies, undo and project saving. Projects use format version 7.

ComfyUI model dropdowns are populated by the connected server and saved per endpoint. Workflows resolve model files in server subfolders and validate missing models and nodes before uploading images. LAN and shared model storage need no client-side model paths. Windows packages remain self-contained and include the setup guide.

The AI fork preview adds ComfyUI editing workflows, a native document-editing Assistant, reusable JavaScript scripts and plugins, input dialogs, real ruler guides and canvas-aware text fitting. Windows downloads include a self-contained executable and launch batch file without an SDK requirement. AI model weights are not bundled.

An AI agent can drive the editor through a Model Context Protocol server, a Painterly filter turns a photo into a painting that is still that photo, letters of a text layer can have their own colors, saving writes in the background, sliders show their colors and can be reset, and Motion Blur's angle has a full-circle dial.

Photoshop Large Document files, editable Photoshop text, SVG import, a memory budget for the whole document, sliders you drag, scrub or type into, a dial for shadow angles, and a color picker laid out as Photoshop's.

The first stable release, and the first for Windows: an installer and a portable zip for x64 and arm64, with ImageMagick included so HEIC, AVIF, TIFF and camera RAW open without anything else installed.
The Camera Raw Filter, finishing filters, blur and noise adjustment layers, the Inner Glow effect, layer copy and paste, Image Trim, and a notice when a newer version is available.
The first release with downloadable packages for Linux.
